entities.name: Kelse
entities.description: A human peasant mother whose prayers were the last Avacyn heard in her pure form.

entities.name: Maeli
entities.description: Kelse's son, who got lost in the woods.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: Angel who rescued Maeli, began her descent into madness, and later burned Kelse's village.

entities.name: Emrakul
entities.description: Eldrazi whose presence made itself known on Innistrad.

events.summary: Avacyn finds the lost Maeli and brings him back to Kelse.
events.quote: Avacyn swooped in and found the boy, bringing him back to his mother

events.summary: Emrakul's presence makes itself known, and Avacyn begins her descent into madness.
events.quote: Avacyn started her descent into madness from that point

events.summary: Kelse sends Maeli running into the forest as corrupted Avacyn and her angels return.
events.quote: Kelse commanded Maeli to run into the forest like before

events.summary: Avacyn and her angels burn the whole village and Avacyn burns Kelse to ash.
events.quote: Avacyn herself made particularly sure to burn Kelse to ash.

relations.quote: Avacyn herself made particularly sure to burn Kelse to ash.
